hook.name: EqtInrUsdtTreasuryHook
hook.description: After EQT→USDT swaps on BSC, routes EQT proceeds to a configurable treasury address and distributes USDT output to a recipient (defaulting to the swap sender). Supports optional hookData to specify a custom recipient, minimum USDT output, and deadline; only active for the hardcoded EQT/USDT pair, and can be paused by the owner.
